A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same AVA-Bench study, with readable figures, tables, equations and appendices A–G. References move ahead of the supplementary material in v5, but the corresponding content can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v3 reports original evaluations of nine VFMs across 14 atomic visual abilities, alongside ablations, subgroup analyses and computational-efficiency results.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the overall evaluations in Table 5 and supplementary analyses in Appendices B, C and F.

M1.justification: The frozen-VFM evaluation procedure, two-stage LLaVA preparation and per-AVA connector/LoRA fine-tuning remain unchanged. The refreshed Figure 4 depicts the same components and training stages.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 14 AVAs, 26 source datasets and represented domains. The newly specified merged action-category count and revised sampling caps do not establish an addition or removal of task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: Table 5 retains the same nine VFMs: SigLIP-1/2, AIMv2, CLIP, InternVL-2.5, RADIOv2.1, DINOv2, SAM and MiDaS-3.0. The comparator sets in the evaluator-size comparison, hyperparameter study and efficiency table also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix A.2 changes the stated action sampling from up to 500 training and 100 validation videos per class to 40 training and 10 testing videos. This is a localized revision to the reported sampling protocol; the unchanged totals and results do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Both retain the bounding-box and object-size analyses in Figure 8, hyperparameter exploration in Table 3, connector probing in Section 6 and subgroup analyses in Figures 21–28. Refreshed illustrative images introduce no additional experimental analysis.

E5.justification: Fixed-seed data-curation statements remain unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests or performance-uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: The result tables and plots retain their numerical entries and findings. For example, Table 5 reports SigLIP-2 OCR ANLS of 81.18 and action accuracy of 45.33 in both versions. No updated results accompany the revised action-sampling description.

T1.justification: The AVA definitions in Table 1 and metric equations in Appendix B are unchanged. Neither version introduces additional theorems, proofs, assumptions or mathematical derivations.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain a diagnostic benchmark separating 14 AVAs, guidance on VFM strengths and weaknesses, and a lightweight evaluator preserving similar rankings with approximately eightfold lower preparation cost. No substantive claim is added, removed or strengthened.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning language supervision, connector information loss, task-specific VFM strengths and the limited applicability of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis are retained. Minor wording edits do not alter these explanations or qualifications.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 newly specifies 301 action categories after label merging and revises the action-curation instructions. New acknowledgments identify the Ohio Supercomputer Center as a computing provider. Hyperparameters, model specifications, reported computational costs and project access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 117 works and retain the same positioning relative to VFM evaluation, AVSBench and compositional visual tuning. Reference relocation and bibliographic formatting changes do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v5 repairs the unresolved figure reference, adds explicit appendix section references and makes limited prose corrections. Authorship, affiliations and an author footnote change, acknowledgments are added, and references move before the appendices. The scientific narrative is otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Figures 1, 3, 4 and 15 receive image-resolution, sizing or other rendering adjustments, with minor page reflow. Their scientific content remains equivalent, and the result plots and table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revised action-sampling instructions align more closely with Table 2's retained 12K training and 3K testing totals, while repaired figure and appendix references improve navigation. These are limited reproducibility and readability gains. The newly stated 301 action categories remain unreconciled with the main text's 302, and the experimental evidence is unchanged.
